name: pikku-content
description: Files in an app: upload, photo, image, document, PDF, attachment, avatar, receipt, download link, `content`, getUploadURL, getDownloadURL, readFileAsBuffer. Open before a function takes a file as input. Who may read one is pikku-permissions; a model reading one is pikku-agent.

findings.excerpt: `fetch(new URL(uploadUrl, serverUrl), { method: uploadMethod ?? 'PUT', headers: { 'Content-Type': file.type, ...uploadHeaders }, body: file })`
